item.title: Local youth camps enhancing safety measures following new legislation
item.description: Following the devastating floods in July 2025 that took place at Camp Mystic, claiming the lives of 27 young girls, the Texas Legislature passed new laws to enhance youth camper safety. In the Texas Panhandle, local youth camps are taking new measures in the wake of the law.

item.title: What the future holds for the Panhandle-Plains Historical Museum
item.description: The Panhandle-Plains Historical Museum has remained closed since the a fire marshal report cited safety violations. WT President Walter Wendler decided to close the museum in March, citing danger to the public.
